$comment: Hand-written metadata for the no-code assets. Names and descriptions of skills come from each SKILL.md, prompt text from the prompt files; scripts/build_no_code_catalog.py merges all of it into the demo app. Paths are relative to this file.

skills.title: Incident report writing
skills.tagline: Turn a spoken incident or safety observation into a Word report.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the incident-report-writing skill to turn my audio recording into an incident report. I will attach the file next.

skills.title: Construction diary creation
skills.tagline: Turn a site manager's spoken day into a Työmaapäiväkirja.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the construction-diary-creation skill to create today's Työmaapäiväkirja from my site recording. I will attach the audio next.

skills.title: Purchase order processing
skills.tagline: Match a purchase order and its BOMs against a price list and produce a priced sales order.
skills.input: PO, BOM PDFs and a price list
skills.tryPrompt: Use the purchase-order-processing skill to turn my purchase order, its BOMs and the price list into a priced sales order. I will attach the files next.

skills.title: Report writing
skills.tagline: Consolidate recordings, notes and documents into one structured Word report.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the report-writing skill to write a report from the materials I am about to attach. Infer the sections from the content.

skills.title: Parsing documents
skills.tagline: Pick a parser that keeps table structure, and catch pages that parsed to nothing.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the parsing-documents skill to choose a parser for my PDFs and check that the tables came through intact.

skills.title: Extracting structured data
skills.tagline: Design an extraction schema that stays inside provider limits and carries checkable evidence.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the extracting-structured-data skill to design a schema for the invoices in this folder and add page and quote evidence to each field.

skills.title: Searching documents
skills.tagline: Build hybrid pgvector and full-text search that fails visibly, including for Finnish text.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the searching-documents skill to add hybrid search over my document chunks and measure it with Hit@K.

prompts.title: Incident report writing
prompts.tagline: Extract a fixed 17-field incident form from a transcript.
prompts.then: Paste the transcript of your recording.

prompts.title: Safety observation reporting
prompts.tagline: Extract a 13-field safety observation from a transcript or note.

prompts.title: Construction diary creation
prompts.tagline: Extract the fields of a daily construction site diary from a transcript.
prompts.then: Paste the transcript of your recording.

prompts.title: Purchase order processing
prompts.tagline: Read a purchase order, match its lines to a price list and calculate the costs.
prompts.input: PO PDF, optional BOM PDFs, price list PDF
prompts.then: Attach the PDFs to the same message.
